categories.name: Kids
categories.desc: Learning games for the little ones: letters, numbers, music.

categories.name: Games
categories.desc: 3D racing, fishing, chess, puzzles and classics.

categories.name: Retro consoles
categories.desc: Classic consoles: WASM-4, Game Boy, Arduboy and CHIP-8 games, all free to play.

categories.name: Productivity
categories.desc: Focus timers, dashboards and everyday tools for your desk.

categories.name: Smart home
categories.desc: Control lights, plugs and sensors on your network.

categories.name: Knowledge
categories.desc: Offline encyclopedias and dictionaries for ANIMA: Wikipedia and word lookups in five languages, no network...

categories.name: Terminal
categories.desc: Programs for the Terminal: Lua, JavaScript, BASIC, SQLite, text adventures.

apps.name: JavaScript
apps.author: QuickJS-ng project (Bellard, Gordon, contributors)
apps.description: Modern JavaScript (ES2024) with QuickJS-ng: interactive prompt, scripts and modules, std/os file APIs, timers. Type js, or js file.js.

apps.name: Lua
apps.author: Lua.org, PUC-Rio
apps.description: Lua 5.4 in the Terminal: interactive prompt and scripts. Type lua for the prompt, lua script.lua to run a file from /sdcard/home.

apps.name: RetroLove
apps.author: Jon Thysell
apps.description: Three arcade classics in one: Pong, Breakout and Asteroids, vector style, with touch controls and keyboard. A LÖVE game running unchanged on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: SQLite
apps.author: SQLite developers (D. Richard Hipp et al.)
apps.description: The SQLite shell: local SQL databases on the SD card, with JSON and math functions. Type sqlite3 notes.db.

apps.name: Sudoku
apps.author: Azdren Ymeri (generator and solver), NucleoOS (touch UI)
apps.description: Endless Sudoku in three levels: a fresh puzzle every time, clashes shown in red, timer and best times, the game kept when you leave. Touch or keyboard.

apps.name: ABC 123
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Learn letters and numbers with 7 mini-games. Multilingual, with voice.

apps.name: Air quality
apps.author: NucleoOS (data: Open-Meteo, CAMS)
apps.description: Air quality where you are: European AQI, PM2.5, PM10, NO2, ozone, UV index and pollen, with the next 24 hours. Open-Meteo data (CAMS), no account or key; search any city.

apps.name: Cannon
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Artillery arcade: drag your finger to set angle and power, lift it to fire.

apps.name: Chess
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Chess against the computer, powered by the mcu-max engine. You play white: tap a piece, then its square. Three levels, undo, check, mate and draw rules, and your game is saved.

apps.name: CHIP-8 Arcade
apps.author: NucleoOS; games by the CHIP-8 Community Archive authors
apps.description: 83 homebrew games from the CHIP-8 Community Archive (CC0) in a CHIP-8 / SUPER-CHIP / XO-CHIP console. On-screen keypad, gamepad and keyboard, colours and sound.

apps.name: Converter
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Unit converter for twelve quantities: length, mass, temperature, volume, area, speed, pressure, energy, data, time, angle and fuel consumption. Type once, read every unit at the same time.

apps.name: Devices
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Shelly, WLED and Tasmota on your Wi-Fi, found automatically: see which are on and switch them with a tap. No Home Assistant, no cloud.

apps.name: Doom Engine
apps.author: NucleoOS (doomgeneric, Chocolate Doom, emu8950)
apps.description: The classic Doom engine (doomgeneric, from Chocolate Doom) tuned for this board: 4:3 picture, OPL music, keyboard, mouse and gamepads. Runs the Doom games from the Store and your own WADs.

apps.name: English dictionary
apps.author: Wiktionary · WikDict/FreeDict · Open English WordNet
apps.description: ANIMA offline: English definitions, synonyms, opposites and word forms. English is the bridge for translating between the other languages: install it with the ones you use. 17 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Home
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Home Assistant dashboard: lights, plugs, covers, thermostats, scenes and sensors by room. Tap to switch, tap a light's bar for brightness.

apps.name: Italian dictionary
apps.author: Wiktionary · WikDict/FreeDict · Open English WordNet
apps.description: ANIMA offline: Italian definitions, synonyms, opposites and word forms, plus Italian-English translation. Also needed to translate Italian into Spanish, French and German. 29 MB on the SD.

apps.name: openHASP
apps.author: openHASP contributors (HASwitchPlate)
apps.description: openHASP (HASwitchPlate): touch pages for Home Assistant described in JSONL and driven over MQTT. Works with the openHASP integration from HACS.

apps.name: Pianino
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: A colourful kids piano: rainbow keys and four instrument presets.

apps.name: Pomodoro Desk Hub
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Smart 7-inch desk dashboard: Pomodoro focus timer, monthly calendar, productivity stats, and dim night stand mode.

apps.name: Puzzles
apps.author: Simon Tatham et al.
apps.description: Simon Tatham's Portable Puzzle Collection: 40 logic puzzles (Bridges, Keen, Light Up, Loopy, Mines, Net, Pattern, Solo, Tents, Untangle...). Undo, solver, puzzle types; games are saved. MIT.

apps.name: Python
apps.author: MicroPython (Damien P. George and contributors)
apps.description: Python 3 (MicroPython 1.26) in the Terminal: interactive prompt, scripts and modules (os, json, re, math, random...). Type python, or python script.py.

apps.name: Timer
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Stopwatch and countdown with an end beep. Big, tap-friendly digits.

apps.name: Vertice Bass
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Arcade fishing tournament in 3D: drive the boat, cast, work the lure, set the hook and fight the fish against the clock. Six lakes, eight species, four lures, weather and time of day, a soundtrack and a top-10 record wall with your...
apps.notes: 2.2.3: crisp lettering on one baseline. 2.2.2: no crack at the fish's tail joint; one fish at a time on the lure and on the line. 2.2.1: true-to-size...

apps.name: Vertice GP
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: 3D kart racing on the Vertice engine: four karts, three laps, drift turbo, boost pads, coins, rocket starts and slipstream. Touch, keyboard or gamepad.

apps.name: Weather
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Live global weather and forecasts powered by Open-Meteo with geolocation, settings, and animated graphics.

apps.name: Wikipedia in English
apps.author: Wikipedia · Kiwix/openZIM · Wikidata
apps.description: The 49.000 most important Wikipedia articles in English, offline: ANIMA answers "who is" and "what is" with no network, citing the source. 48 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Wikipedia in Italian
apps.author: Wikipedia · Kiwix/openZIM · Wikidata
apps.description: The 49.000 most important Wikipedia articles in Italian, offline: ANIMA answers "who is" and "what is" with no network, citing the source. 22 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Zigbee
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Zigbee2MQTT on the panel: devices appear by themselves, toggle lights and plugs, see temperature, humidity, doors, motion and battery. Needs the MQTT broker in Settings > Home.

apps.name: Zork I-III
apps.author: Infocom / Microsoft; MojoZork by Ryan C. Gordon
apps.description: Zork I, II and III, the classic 1980 text adventures, free under the MIT license. Type zork in the Terminal, or zork 2 for Zork II. SAVE and RESTORE keep one game per title.

apps.author: Przemek Bdaruk (Przemekkkth)
apps.description: Slide the tiles and merge equal numbers until you reach 2048. Swipe in any direction; keyboard: arrows. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: BASIC
apps.author: Adam Dunkels (uBASIC), Nucleo port
apps.description: Classic line-numbered BASIC: print/if/goto/gosub/for-next/input. Type basic prog.bas to run a program from /sdcard/home. Lowercase keywords, single-letter variables a-z.

apps.name: dateutils
apps.author: Sebastian Freundt
apps.description: dateutils: date arithmetic in the Terminal. dateadd, datediff, dateseq, dateconv, dateround, datetest, dategrep and strptime count days, weeks, months and business days. Type datediff 2026-10-02 2026-12-25.

apps.name: Eigenmath
apps.author: George Weigt
apps.description: Eigenmath, symbolic math in the Terminal: derivatives, integrals, equations, matrices and exact numbers of any size. Type eigenmath for the prompt, or eigenmath -e 'd(sin(x)^2,x)' for one answer.

apps.name: GNU units
apps.author: Adrian Mariano, Russ Rogers and the Free Software Foundation
apps.description: GNU units converts between more than 3000 units of measure and computes with them: lengths, speeds, energy, cooking, temperatures, currencies, chemical elements. Type units '5 mph' 'km/hr', or units for the interactive prompt.

apps.name: html2text
apps.author: Martin Bayer, Arno Unkrig and the html2text contributors
apps.description: html2text turns web pages and HTML files into readable plain text: headings, lists, tables, links. Type curl -s https://example.org | html2text, or html2text page.html.

apps.name: lowdown
apps.author: Kristaps Dzonsons
apps.description: lowdown shows Markdown files formatted in the Terminal and converts them to HTML, man pages, LaTeX or OpenDocument. Type lowdown -tterm README.md.

apps.name: PDFio tools
apps.author: Michael R Sweet
apps.description: PDF tools from PDFio: pdftotext extracts the text of a PDF, pdfinfo shows its details and pages, pdfmerge joins several PDFs. Type pdftotext document.pdf.

apps.name: qrencode
apps.author: Kentaro Fukuchi and the libqrencode contributors
apps.description: qrencode turns text, links and Wi-Fi credentials into a QR code drawn right in the Terminal, ready to scan with a phone, or saved as an SVG file. Type qrencode https://example.org.

apps.name: zstd
apps.author: Meta Platforms (zstd), Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler (zlib), the Tukaani project (xz)
apps.description: zstd compresses and decompresses files: Zstandard (.zst), gzip (.gz) and xz (.xz). It answers to zstd, gzip, gunzip, zcat, xz, unxz and xzcat. Type gunzip file.gz.

apps.name: bc calculator
apps.author: Gavin D. Howard and contributors
apps.description: bc, the arbitrary-precision calculator: numbers with as many digits as you want, functions, and a math library (bc -l). Type bc and write expressions like 2^200 or sqrt(2).

apps.name: Berry
apps.author: Guan Wenliang and the Berry contributors
apps.description: Berry, a small object-oriented scripting language for microcontrollers: interactive prompt and scripts. Type berry for the prompt, berry script.be to run a file from /sdcard/home.

apps.name: Checkers
apps.author: Henrique Barcia Lang
apps.description: English draughts for two players on one screen: tap a piece, then tap where it goes; captures are compulsory. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Compressed
apps.author: Redoxee
apps.description: A game in under 200 lines: dodge and stomp the falling blocks, chain stomps for a combo. On-screen d-pad and Jump. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: FIGlet
apps.author: Glenn Chappell, Ian Chai, John Cowan, Christiaan Keet, Claudio Matsuoka
apps.description: FIGlet writes text in big letters made of characters, with 15 built-in fonts. Type figlet Hello, or figlet -f slant Hello; figlet --list shows the fonts.

apps.name: Fly Swatter
apps.author: sleepycharlyy
apps.description: Swat the flies before they swarm the screen, and mind the bombs. Tap where the fly is. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: French dictionary
apps.author: Wiktionary · WikDict/FreeDict · Open English WordNet
apps.description: ANIMA offline: French-English translation and French word forms. With the Italian dictionary it also translates to and from Italian. 11 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Game Boy
apps.author: Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei, MiniGB APU by Alex Baines; NucleoOS
apps.description: Game Boy player (Peanut-GB, MIT): plays your own .gb games from /sdcard/home/roms with touch controls, gamepads, sound and battery saves. Homebrew: hh.gbdev.io.

apps.name: German dictionary
apps.author: Wiktionary · WikDict/FreeDict · Open English WordNet
apps.description: ANIMA offline: German-English translation and German word forms. With the Italian dictionary it also translates to and from Italian. 13 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Glulxe
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin (Glulxe, CheapGlk)
apps.description: Modern interactive fiction (Inform 7 / Glulx) in the Terminal. Copy a .gblorb or .ulx story to /sdcard/home, then type glulxe story.gblorb. Thousands of free games on ifdb.org.

apps.name: Gravity Wars
apps.author: Boris (whyboris)
apps.description: Artillery among the planets: aim, choose the power and let gravity bend the shot towards the other ship. Two players on one screen. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: jq
apps.author: Stephen Dolan and the jq contributors (regex: Oniguruma, K. Kosako)
apps.description: jq, the command-line JSON processor: filter, transform and pretty-print JSON files, with regular expressions. Type jq '.name' data.json, or pipe JSON into it.

apps.name: JSON
apps.author: Dave Gamble and cJSON contributors
apps.description: Validate, pretty-print, minify and query JSON files: cjson file.json, cjson -c file.json (compact), cjson -q .foo.bar file.json (pick a value), cjson -l file.jsonl (one value per line).

apps.name: Lua App
apps.author: NucleoOS (Lua 5.4 by Lua.org, PUC-Rio; json.lua by rxi; Montserrat by the Montserrat Project)
apps.description: The engine of the Store's Lua apps: Lua 5.4 with drawing, anti-aliased text, touch, keys, gamepads, timers, storage, HTTP, WebSocket, MQTT and Home Assistant, plus a LÖVE compatibility layer. On its own it runs the scripts you copy to...
apps.license: MIT (engine, Lua, json.lua), SIL OFL 1.1 (Montserrat font)

apps.name: Markdown
apps.author: Martin Mitá (md4c)
apps.description: Render Markdown to HTML: md notes.md (HTML on stdout), md -f -o out.html notes.md (full document), md --gfm (GitHub-flavored tables/strikethrough/task lists).

apps.name: Minesweeper
apps.author: Henrique Barcia Lang
apps.description: The classic mine-clearing puzzle: tap a cell to open it, numbers tell how many mines touch it. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Moon Pong
apps.author: Om Rawaley
apps.description: Pong against the computer. Hold the on-screen arrows (or Up/Down on a keyboard or pad) to move your paddle. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: MQTT Explorer
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: See what flows on your MQTT broker: topics as they arrive, payloads with JSON pretty-printed, a short history per topic, publish test messages. Uses the broker set in Settings > Home.

apps.name: Mr. Rescue
apps.author: Tangram Games (Simon Larsen)
apps.description: A fireman with a water cannon fights his way up burning buildings, throws the people he rescues out of the windows and faces the arsonist bosses. On-screen d-pad, Jump, Water, Grab. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Panda Shooter
apps.author: PR454D
apps.description: A tiny shooter: move left and right and hit the bouncing panda boss before it gets you. On-screen arrows and Fire, or a keyboard or pad. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: pForth
apps.author: Phil Burk, Larry Polansky, David Rosenboom
apps.description: pForth, a portable ANS Forth: stack-based interactive programming, with floating point and file words. Type pforth for the prompt, pforth file.fth to load a file.

apps.name: Robo House
apps.author: Foppygames
apps.description: A one-screen platformer: run, climb the ladders and jump over the robots to rescue the kittens in the house. On-screen d-pad and Jump. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: RPN Calc
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: A reverse Polish notation calculator in the HP tradition: unlimited stack, undo, memory, trigonometry in degrees or radians, logarithms, powers and factorials. The stack is kept between sessions.

apps.name: Scheme
apps.author: Dimitrios Souflis, Kevin Cozens and the TinyScheme contributors
apps.description: TinyScheme, a small Scheme (R5RS subset): interactive prompt and scripts, with 64-bit integers, floats, strings, vectors and files. Type scheme for the prompt, scheme file.scm to run a file.

apps.name: ScummVM (cge)
apps.author: The ScummVM Team; NucleoOS port
apps.description: ScummVM 2.9.1 engine 'cge' for Soltys. Installed with the game.

apps.name: ScummVM (cge2)
apps.author: The ScummVM Team; NucleoOS port
apps.description: ScummVM 2.9.1 engine 'cge2' for Sfinx. Installed with the game.

apps.name: ScummVM (drascula)
apps.author: The ScummVM Team; NucleoOS port
apps.description: ScummVM 2.9.1 engine 'drascula' for Drascula: The Vampire Strikes Back. Installed with the game.

apps.name: ScummVM (dreamweb)
apps.author: The ScummVM Team; NucleoOS port
apps.description: ScummVM 2.9.1 engine 'dreamweb' for DreamWeb. Installed with the game.

apps.name: ScummVM (lure)
apps.author: The ScummVM Team; NucleoOS port
apps.description: ScummVM 2.9.1 engine 'lure' for Lure of the Temptress. Installed with the game.

apps.name: ScummVM (parallaction)
apps.author: The ScummVM Team; NucleoOS port
apps.description: ScummVM 2.9.1 engine 'parallaction' for Nippon Safes, Inc.. Installed with the game.

apps.name: ScummVM (queen)
apps.author: The ScummVM Team; NucleoOS port
apps.description: ScummVM 2.9.1 engine 'queen' for Flight of the Amazon Queen. Installed with the game.

apps.name: ScummVM (sky)
apps.author: The ScummVM Team; NucleoOS port
apps.description: ScummVM 2.9.1 engine 'sky' for Beneath a Steel Sky. Installed with the game.

apps.name: Slide Puzzle
apps.author: Przemysaw Bdaruk (Przemekkkth), after Al Sweigart
apps.description: The fifteen puzzle: put the numbered tiles back in order. Tap a tile next to the gap to slide it, or swipe. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Spanish dictionary
apps.author: Wiktionary · WikDict/FreeDict · Open English WordNet
apps.description: ANIMA offline: Spanish-English translation and Spanish word forms. With the Italian dictionary it also translates to and from Italian. 25 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Sword of the Orc King
apps.author: Foppygames
apps.description: A turn-based roguelike in progress: explore the dungeon, fight orcs and bats, pick up what you find. On-screen d-pad and buttons, or a keyboard. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Synth
apps.author: NucleoOS + AMY (Brian Whitman, Dan Ellis)
apps.description: Polyphonic synthesizer on the AMY engine: 128 Juno-106 and 128 DX7 patches plus a piano. Two-octave multi-touch keyboard, ten presets, volume, tone and reverb.

apps.name: Tcl
apps.author: Steve Bennett, Salvatore Sanfilippo and the Jim Tcl contributors
apps.description: Tcl in the Terminal (Jim Tcl): interactive prompt and scripts, with lists, dicts, regexp, OO and file I/O. Type tcl for the prompt, tcl script.tcl to run a file.

apps.name: Tetronimo
apps.author: Przemekkkth (after Al Sweigart's Tetromino)
apps.description: A clean falling-blocks puzzle: tap to rotate, swipe left or right to move, swipe down to drop. Keyboard: arrows, space, P to pause. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Tic Tac Toe
apps.author: Rafael Jacov Medel
apps.description: Noughts and crosses against a friend or an unbeatable minimax bot with three levels. Tap to play. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Total Breakout
apps.author: Thomas (Shepardeon)
apps.description: Break all the bricks with the ball and the paddle. On-screen arrows and Go, or a keyboard or pad. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Ubo
apps.author: Romain Meynet (chezrom)
apps.description: A Qix-like: draw lines to cut off parts of the field and claim them while the enemies roam. On-screen d-pad and Draw. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Vertice Bass soundtrack
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: The music of Vertice Bass: six lake themes, menu, fight and champion tracks. Installed with the game.

apps.name: Wikipedia in French
apps.author: Wikipedia · Kiwix/openZIM · Wikidata
apps.description: The 49.000 most important Wikipedia articles in French, offline: ANIMA answers "who is" and "what is" with no network, citing the source. 27 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Wikipedia in German
apps.author: Wikipedia · Kiwix/openZIM · Wikidata
apps.description: The 49.000 most important Wikipedia articles in German, offline: ANIMA answers "who is" and "what is" with no network, citing the source. 24 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Wikipedia in Spanish
apps.author: Wikipedia · Kiwix/openZIM · Wikidata
apps.description: The 49.000 most important Wikipedia articles in Spanish, offline: ANIMA answers "who is" and "what is" with no network, citing the source. 32 MB on the SD.

apps.name: Wormy
apps.author: Przemysaw Bdaruk (Przemekkkth), after Al Sweigart
apps.description: The snake game: eat the apples, grow longer, do not bite yourself or the walls. Swipe to turn; keyboard: arrows. A LÖVE game on the Lua App engine.

apps.name: Wren
apps.author: Robert Nystrom and the Wren contributors
apps.description: Wren, a small, fast class-based scripting language: interactive prompt and scripts, with a mini io module (Stdin, File). Type wren for the prompt, wren script.wren to run a file.

apps.name: Zip
apps.author: Rich Geldreich and contributors (miniz)
apps.description: Create, list and extract .zip archives: zip archive.zip file1 file2 (create), zip -l archive.zip (list), zip -x archive.zip [dir] (extract).
